data.name: Amran
data.gender_notes: Amran is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Amran is an Arabic name that signifies a high status or exalted position. It is also the name of a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The name Amran carries the meaning “High Status, Exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Amran usually hope their child will grow to embody high status, exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Amran is mentioned in the Quran as a righteous servant of Allah (Surah Al-Imran, 3:33).
data.etymology: Amran belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “High Status, Exalted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amran total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

Historically, it was the name of a respected companion of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), and therefore, it is associated with the highest ideals of loyalty, reverence, and devotion to Islam.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Amran carries the deeper meaning of being from the chosen and exalted. It implies a special relationship with the divine, conveying a sense of spiritual elevation and closeness to the Creator. The name calls forth a commitment to following the path of truth and righteousness, and striving for personal growth and self-improvement.
